attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 11
attributes.name: Restore Mythic Power
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to allow a character that has fewer mythic charges than the scenario's adventure deck number to get 1 charge.

After plaything this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, if you would discard it, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 13 check to recharge it instead.
